answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a verifiable work history, like an atlas mapping every agent's past attestations. New agents enter through a small trellis of trusted introducers who stake reputation on them, so spawning fake identities costs real social capital. Honest behavior then earns a velvet-smooth trust score that unlocks higher-value tasks, while sybils that burn their introducers' stake get pruned fast.
